subject: Mutual Action Plan & Security Gates for FintechEdge evaluation
messages:
From: Lena O'Connor <lena@fintechedge.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:08:00 -0500
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + security gates for Redwood eval

Hi Rishi & Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here at FintechEdge is keen to run a short evaluation. Before we start, our security and procurement teams asked for a clear mutual action plan that lays out the compliance gates we need to close during the evaluation. High level asks from security: SOC 2 Type II evidence (latest report + auditor letter), completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet (we typically import CAIQ answers into our tooling), a redline-ready DPA, and confirmation of data retention and deletion controls for evaluation data (we will run production-like traffic against the API).

Our proposed timeline is four weeks:
- Week 1: Security intake & document exchange
- Week 2: Integration + initial functional eval
- Week 3: Security Q&A and live audit/demo
- Week 4: Exec review + procurement (DPA sign, PO)

Can you confirm you can deliver the SOC2 evidence and the CAIQ within 3 business days, and share a DPA draft we can start redlining? Also, what's Redwood's default retention period for customer-sent inputs during a private evaluation, and can we cap it at 60 days for this pilot?

Attaching our draft MAP template and a short list of security questions.

Thanks,
Lena O'Connor
Head of Integrations
FintechEdge

Attachment: fintechedge-kickoff-MAP.docx (docx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena O'Connor <lena@fintechedge.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + security gates for Redwood eval

Hi Lena — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely run to the four-week MAP you outlined. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2 Type II: we can send our latest report + auditor letter within 48 hours under NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a completed CAIQ + internal mapping; we'll export the CAIQ spreadsheet and push it to the Drive link.
- DPA: attaching a Draft_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf for your legal team to start redlining.
- Data retention: default for hosted evals is 90 days, but for this pilot we can contractually cap at 60 days and disable retention for sensitive fields — details to be captured in the DPA.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) We'll upload: redwood-soc2-2025-type2.pdf, redwood-sig-responses.xlsx, Draft_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf to a shared secure folder by EOD tomorrow.
2) Dev (cc'd) will schedule a 45-min security/integration call this week to walk the CAIQ answers and confirm API audit logs/audit access points.
3) If you can confirm the procurement timeline and PO owner, we'll align the MAP calendar and exec review slot for Week 4.

I'll send a formal MAP doc with dates once we have your PO owner and preferred week-1 start date.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0183

Attachment stub: Draft_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lena O'Connor <lena@fintechedge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:11:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + security gates for Redwood eval

Hi Lena — quick technical checklist to make sure the Week 1 exchange is efficient:

From our side we'll provide:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + auditor cover letter
- Completed SIG/CAIQ export (xlsx) with control references to our SOC 2 controls
- API logging and retention summary (doc) showing retention windows, deletion workflows, and who has access to raw request logs
- Sample audit log extracts and schema for SIEM ingestion (if you want to pull into your tooling)

A couple of clarifying questions for you:
1) When you say "production-like traffic," can you estimate expected qps and average request size (tokens)? that'll help us advise on whether to run you on a Dedicated dev pool vs hosted evaluation.
2) For the CAIQ, do you need the CAIQ in JSON export or XLSX? we can do both.
3) Who on your legal team will own the DPA redline? (we see "FintechEdge Legal <legal@fintechedge.com>" in CC; if you can point to a specific reviewer that speeds things up)

I'll schedule the security/integration call for Wed 18 Feb at 11:00 AM ET unless you prefer another slot — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Lena O'Connor <lena@fintechedge.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: FintechEdge Legal <legal@fintechedge.com>, Rob Hayes <rob.hayes@fintechedge.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:23:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + security gates for Redwood eval

Thanks — this all looks good. Answers below:
- Traffic estimate: peak ~40 qps, average request size ~1.2k tokens (mostly embeddings + short prompts). If you recommend a dedicated dev pool for stability, note that procurement will need approximate cost numbers early in Week 2.
- CAIQ: XLSX preferred; will import to our vendor security tool.
- DPA reviewer: Janice Murray (legal@fintechedge.com) will lead redlines; she expects to complete first-pass within 3 business days.

We confirm the 60-day retention cap for the pilot — please reflect that in the DPA and retention summary.

The Wed 18 Feb 11:00 AM ET call works for us. Please include a Drive link for the artifacts and a DocuSign link for the DPA when available.

Next steps per MAP:
- Rishi: upload SOC2 + CAIQ + DPA draft to shared folder by EOD Tue 2/17 (you said 48h)
- Dev: secure/integration call Wed 2/18 11:00 AM ET to walk CAIQ and audit logs
- Janice (FintechEdge Legal): DPA pass 1 by Fri 2/20; aim to get PO/exec review scheduled for Week 4 (Mar 15–19)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

Best,
Lena
Head of Integrations | FintechEdge

Links: https://drive.google.com/fintechedge/sig-evidence
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123 (placeholder)
__thread_summary: Four-message thread coordinating a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and security/compliance gates for a four-week evaluation of Redwood Inference by FintechEdge. Internal participants (rishi_malhotra, dev_patel, marissa_cole) commit to delivering SOC2, SIG/CAIQ, and a draft DPA; FintechEdge confirms traffic profile, DPA reviewer, and 60-day retention cap. Planned integration/security call and artifact uploads scheduled.
